items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: when you can see the famous names and Milton Berle on television

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. But you know what happened, Monk, was that around New York, a big city like this, you know rent was fairly cheap, not like today, you know. The trouble with New York today is there are too many people with too much money. And in those days rent was reasonable, a lot of little restaurants, clubs, bars, bars would have little bands. Weekends if nothing else. Or Ryan’s started as a bar, that went on for years, that wasn’t supposed to be a jazz nightclub or anything. So that just sort of all disappeared.…
And it costs a lot to go to them often times.
